integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof with exact finite-field computations reproduced by standalone deterministic code; this is a self-review only, with no independent external validation.
limitations: Results concern finite simple open path–clique Cartesian products, binary synchronous open-neighbour XOR, n=2^s-1 with s>=2 and q>=2; the adjacent-column invertibility statement applies at lengths 4^r. No assertion for general graph products, weighted/asynchronous updates or other fields. Established one-dimensional Dirichlet Rule 90 nilpotence is acknowledged as prior work. Finite checks are not proofs of the universal theorem. Historical search cannot exclude an unindexed equivalent.
title: Dyadic clique strips: identical periodic-orbit censuses with opposite transient behaviour
